title: Delivery preferences

email.description: verified identity-owned email or verification workflow. No blind forward to arbitrary recipient

webhook_endpoint_id.description: owned preverified endpoint;SSRF-safe registry. Raw URL uses separate secure validation

categories.description: known category IDs. Safety follows agreed policy, not marketing toggle

timezone.description: IANA zone. Schedule uses local wall time with DST rules

quiet_start.description: HH:mm plus explicit wrap behavior. Safety exceptions shown

quiet_end.description: required with quiet_start. Digest never revives expired entries

marketing_consent.description: separate optional consent. No preselected consent

description: Ready-input schema plus server business validation. Draft input uses identical property types but permits missing required fields; missingness must be displayed. Identity/password forms never saved as drafts.
